scenes.tts: Poke a cell, and a current flows. In twenty ten, nobody knew which protein carried it. How would you find out?
scenes.caption: Poke a cell, and a current flows. In 2010, nobody knew which protein carried it. How would you find out?
scenes.visual: Title card: Which Protein Carries the Poke? A round cultured cell; a glass probe presses its surface and a small inward current trace appears beside it. A question mark hangs over the membrane.
scenes.narration: Poke a cell, and a current flows. In 2010, nobody knew which protein carried it. How would you find out?

scenes.tts: Coste and colleagues used a cultured mouse cell line called Neuro two A. It gave a reliable current when poked.
scenes.caption: Coste and colleagues used a cultured mouse cell line called Neuro2A. It gave a reliable current when poked.
scenes.visual: A Neuro2A cell, labelled 'mouse neuroblastoma line, Neuro2A'. Year card 2010 in a corner.
scenes.narration: Coste and colleagues used a cultured mouse cell line called Neuro2A. It gave a reliable current when poked.

scenes.tts: A separate glass probe pressed on the cell. A patch pipette recorded the whole-cell current.
scenes.visual: The probe indents the cell from the left; a patch pipette seals on the right. A current trace dips each time the probe presses.
scenes.narration: A separate glass probe pressed on the cell. A patch pipette recorded the whole-cell current.

scenes.tts: They silenced candidate genes one at a time, with short interfering RNA. Then they asked which loss reduced the current.
scenes.visual: A row of candidate gene tiles. One at a time, a small siRNA strand silences a tile, and the trace beside it is redrawn, mostly unchanged.
scenes.narration: They silenced candidate genes one at a time, with short interfering RNA. Then they asked which loss reduced the current.

scenes.tts: One candidate stood out. Knocking down a gene called Fam thirty-eight A sharply reduced the current.
scenes.caption: One candidate stood out. Knocking down a gene called Fam38A sharply reduced the current.
scenes.visual: The Fam38A tile lights up. Its trace shrinks to a small blip next to the full control trace. Label: knockdown, sharply reduced.
scenes.narration: One candidate stood out. Knocking down a gene called Fam38A sharply reduced the current.

scenes.tts: The current shrinks when this gene is silenced. What have you shown? And what have you not shown?
scenes.visual: Hold on the two traces, control and knockdown. On screen: What have you shown? What have you not?
scenes.narration: The current shrinks when this gene is silenced. What have you shown? And what have you not shown?

scenes.tts: You have shown the gene is required, for that current, in that cell line. You have not shown its protein is the channel.
scenes.visual: A tick appears beside 'required here (Neuro2A)'. A grey, unticked box beside 'is the channel'.
scenes.narration: You have shown the gene is required, for that current, in that cell line. You have not shown its protein is the channel.

scenes.tts: A required protein could be an accessory subunit. The real pore could be made of something else.
scenes.visual: Schematic: the Piezo protein drawn as a side piece docked to an unknown grey channel whose pore is the one conducting. Label: possible accessory subunit.
scenes.narration: A required protein could be an accessory subunit. The real pore could be made of something else.

scenes.tts: Next, they put the gene into other cultured cells. The renamed gene, Pee-AY-zo one, gave those cells mechanically activated currents.
scenes.caption: Next, they put the gene into other cultured cells. The renamed gene, Piezo1, gave those cells mechanically activated currents.
scenes.visual: A second cell type, labelled 'host cell, introduced gene'. A gene circle enters it; poking now gives a current. Label: Fam38A renamed Piezo1.
scenes.narration: Next, they put the gene into other cultured cells. The renamed gene, Piezo1, gave those cells mechanically activated currents.

scenes.tts: So did a related gene, Pee-AY-zo two. The two currents had different kinetics.
scenes.caption: So did a related gene, Piezo2. The two currents had different kinetics.
scenes.visual: Two traces side by side, Piezo1 and Piezo2, with differently shaped decays. Label: kinetics differ.
scenes.narration: So did a related gene, Piezo2. The two currents had different kinetics.

scenes.tts: Ion substitution pointed to a non-selective cation current for Pee-AY-zo two. And its current inactivated quickly.
scenes.caption: Ion substitution pointed to a non-selective cation current for Piezo2. And its current inactivated quickly.
scenes.visual: The Piezo2 trace rises and decays quickly. Small plus-charged ions of several kinds pass a schematic channel. Label: non-selective cation conductance.
scenes.narration: Ion substitution pointed to a non-selective cation current for Piezo2. And its current inactivated quickly.

scenes.tts: Inactivation means the current decays while the stimulus is held. Keep that word. It returns at the end.
scenes.visual: A held probe step drawn under the trace; the current decays during the hold. The word 'inactivation' is underlined and pinned in a corner.
scenes.narration: Inactivation means the current decays while the stimulus is held. Keep that word. It returns at the end.

scenes.tts: Notice the logic. Silencing showed the gene is necessary. Expression showed it is sufficient. Neither showed that it forms the pore.
scenes.visual: The three-claims figure: Necessity panel lights with a tick, Sufficiency panel lights with a tick, Pore identity panel stays grey.
scenes.narration: Notice the logic. Silencing showed the gene is necessary. Expression showed it is sufficient. Neither showed that it forms the pore.

scenes.tts: The authors said so. They kept open the possibility that Pee-AY-zo proteins were subunits of some other channel.
scenes.caption: The authors said so. They kept open the possibility that Piezo proteins were subunits of some other channel.
scenes.visual: A paper page icon with the sentence highlighted as a schematic: possibly non-conducting subunits. The pore panel remains grey.
scenes.narration: The authors said so. They kept open the possibility that Piezo proteins were subunits of some other channel.

scenes.tts: Necessity, sufficiency and pore identity are three separate claims. Each needs its own experiment. The twenty ten paper earned two.
scenes.caption: Necessity, sufficiency and pore identity are three separate claims. Each needs its own experiment. The 2010 paper earned two.
scenes.visual: Three labelled columns: necessity, sufficiency, pore identity, each with its experiment beneath: knockdown, expression, ?. Count card: 2 of 3.
scenes.narration: Necessity, sufficiency and pore identity are three separate claims. Each needs its own experiment. The 2010 paper earned two.

scenes.tts: Later work earned the third. In twenty twelve, purified Pee-AY-zo one formed ion channels in artificial bilayers and liposomes.
scenes.caption: Later work earned the third. In 2012, purified Piezo1 formed ion channels in artificial bilayers and liposomes.
scenes.visual: The pore panel turns gold: a ring-shaped liposome with one purified Piezo1 block in its wall and no cell. Year card 2012.
scenes.narration: Later work earned the third. In 2012, purified Piezo1 formed ion channels in artificial bilayers and liposomes.

scenes.tts: Structures then placed the pore. The channel's carboxy-terminal domains line a central ion pore.
scenes.visual: A top-down schematic of a trimer with the central pore highlighted. Label: carboxy-terminal domains line the pore.
scenes.narration: Structures then placed the pore. The channel's carboxy-terminal domains line a central ion pore.

scenes.tts: So the protein is the channel. Now a stranger question. Why build so much protein around one central pore?
scenes.visual: Zoom out from the small pore to three long arms spreading far across the membrane. On screen: why so much protein around one pore?
scenes.narration: So the protein is the channel. Now a stranger question. Why build so much protein around one central pore?

scenes.tts: Required, sufficient, and the pore itself. Three claims, three experiments.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: Required. Sufficient. Pore. Three claims, three experiments.
scenes.narration: Required, sufficient, and the pore itself. Three claims, three experiments.
